mutants.name: FAIL_PRECEDENCE_REMOVED
mutants.guarantee: A definite predicate failure must dominate UNKNOWN/PASS aggregation.
mutants.find:
if any(item is VerificationStatus.FAIL for item in statuses):
        return VerificationStatus.FAIL
mutants.replace:
if any(item is VerificationStatus.FAIL for item in statuses):
        return VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN

mutants.name: UNKNOWN_AS_PASS
mutants.guarantee: Incomplete or otherwise unknown evidence must never aggregate to PASS.
mutants.find:
if any(item is VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN for item in statuses):
        return VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN
mutants.replace:
if any(item is VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN for item in statuses):
        return VerificationStatus.PASS

mutants.name: SAME_SEQUENCE_ACCEPTED_AS_FRESH
mutants.guarantee: Post-action evidence must have a strictly newer observation sequence.

mutants.name: IGNORE_CAPABILITY_IDENTITY
mutants.guarantee: Evidence from another capability cannot verify an ExpectedEffect.
mutants.replace:
if False and after.ref.capability != effect.before.capability:
        return result(VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN, "capability_mismatch")

mutants.name: IGNORE_SUBJECT_IDENTITY
mutants.guarantee: Evidence from another subject cannot verify an ExpectedEffect.
mutants.replace:
if False and after.ref.subject != effect.before.subject:
        return result(VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN, "subject_mismatch")

mutants.name: IGNORE_STREAM_IDENTITY
mutants.guarantee: A higher sequence from another observation stream is not fresh evidence for this effect.
mutants.replace:
if False and after.ref.stream_id != effect.before.stream_id:
        return result(VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN, "observation_stream_mismatch")

mutants.name: IGNORE_AMBIGUITY
mutants.guarantee: Ambiguous evidence cannot verify an effect that requires unambiguous observation.
mutants.find:
if effect.require_unambiguous and after.ambiguous:
        return result(VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN, "ambiguous_observation")
mutants.replace:
if False and effect.require_unambiguous and after.ambiguous:
        return result(VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN, "ambiguous_observation")

mutants.name: COMPLETE_MISSING_EQUALS_AS_UNKNOWN
mutants.guarantee: A field missing from a complete observation is definite FAIL, not UNKNOWN.

mutants.name: IGNORE_EVIDENCE_BATCH
mutants.guarantee: Finish Gate evidence must belong to the requested evidence batch.
mutants.find:
if any(item.evidence_batch_id != evidence_batch_id for item in results):
        return VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN
mutants.replace:
if False and any(item.evidence_batch_id != evidence_batch_id for item in results):
        return VerificationStatus.UNKNOWN

mutants.name: CANDIDATE_DONE_IS_DONE
mutants.guarantee: Planner candidate_done=False cannot be ignored by the independent Finish Gate.

mutants.name: IGNORE_UNRESOLVED_REQUIREMENTS
mutants.guarantee: Unresolved completion requirements must block DONE.

mutants.name: IGNORE_SAFETY_FAILURE
mutants.guarantee: A definite safety failure must prevent DONE independently of task success.
